svg.text: PARTITION RUN REFINEMENT · SHARED SUPPORT SOCKETS
Every cell boundary resolves to one coincident support beam; long north/south runs receive their own authored view.
shared beams land exactly on cell-edge sockets
top-down cream/teal strip runs continuously along the floor
shared feet are painted underneath; only their wings remain visible
JOINT CLOSE-UP · ONE BEAM, NOT A BUNCHED PAIR
both module endpoints are centered on the same socket
their support beams coincide into one structural upright
Horizontal modules center their endpoint support on the exact cell-edge socket, so adjacent endpoints overdraw one upright. Vertical modules are authored top-down:
the continuous cream and teal strip paints over each shared support and foot, leaving only the footing wings visible beneath the baffle. Corners use the same
under-baffle ownership at the vertical socket; end-caps retain one unmistakable terminal post.
